# Alfredo by BakingInsightsAI

> Alfredo by BakingInsightsAI is software for restaurants, bars, breweries, cafes and bakeries that reads your POS sales and turns them into a short weekly list of changes worth trying, then tells you honestly whether each one worked.

Alfredo is for restaurants, bars, breweries, cafes and bakeries that ring
their sales through a POS. It reads your sales data and gives the owner a
short weekly list of changes worth trying. You decide what to try. Alfredo
then reports whether it worked, did nothing, or backfired. It recommends and
you decide: nothing on your menu or your prices moves on its own.

Toast and Clover are connected today. Other POS systems on request.

- [Restaurant analytics](https://bakinginsightsai.com/): The opening: what Alfredo is, and a week of suggestions as an owner would see them.

- [Why you can trust the numbers](https://bakinginsightsai.com/honesty.html): Why you can trust the numbers: what Alfredo will and will not say about a result.
- [About us](https://bakinginsightsai.com/pilot.html): About us: why Alfredo exists and where it is today.
- [Pricing, from $99 a month](https://bakinginsightsai.com/pricing.html): Pricing: the three plans, what is in each, and the founding offer.
- [Questions and answers](https://bakinginsightsai.com/faq.html): Questions and answers about Alfredo, in short.

## Pricing

- Counter: $99 a month. For one location.
- House: $199 a month. For one to three locations.
- Group: $299 a month. For four to ten locations.

One price for the whole business, not per location and not per user. No setup
fee, month to month. More than ten locations is arranged directly.
The first 10 businesses get everything free for six months, and 9 of 10 spots are still open.
